name: QSC_ATTRIBUTE_OPTIONS
description: This table is used to store attribute options that can be associated with product groups for defining narrow by filters, search criteria etc.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_OPTION_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for narrow by attribute options. Primary Key.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Internal Name of the attribute.

columns.name: NB_ATTR_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of attribute determines whether it is a Product Attribute, Pricing Attribute etc.

columns.name: NB_ATTR_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.description: Subtype of the attribute. The subtype is related to the type of the attribute defined in the NB_ATTR_TYPE_CODE column.

columns.name: DOMAIN_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of domain for this attribute.

columns.name: NB_DATA_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the narrow by attribute that drives the domain behavior.

columns.name: FORMAT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Format Type for numeric attributes.

columns.name: SORT_BY_ASC_TYPE
columns.description: Defines the ascending sort order options displayed to the user.

columns.name: SORT_BY_DESC_TYPE
columns.description: Defines the descending sort order options displayed to the user.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments for the attribute option.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Refers to the Application Id of the DFF/EFF Context Segment

columns.name: DESCRIPTIVE_FLEXFIELD_CODE
columns.description: Refers to the Descriptive Flexfield Code of the DFF/EFF Context Segment.

columns.name: CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Refers to the DFF/EFF Context Code.

columns.name: SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Refers to the DFF/EFF Segment Code.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Refers to the name of the object that the attribute belongs to.

columns.name: OBJECT_COL_NAME
columns.description: Refers to the name of the column in the referenced table that this attribute is based on.

columns.name: LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Refers to the lookup type code used by this attribute.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: CUSTOMIZATION_LEVEL
columns.description: Used to enforce rules, restricting how and by whom the particular row can be edited.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
